name: Kisekae Fetish!
original_name: 着せかえフェティッシュ！
source:
A little bit future. Many schools have been closed down due to decreasing number of children. As a result, the schools have become job training schools for various jobs. Of course, Yuuki studies at one of them as well. His classmates include Miko, nurse, waitress and so on. It looks extraordinary, but this game is quite an ordinary school adventure game.

[From ErogeShop]
